data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure: Flights tab, trip type, origin and destination, date, Search, Fastest, See flight, Select, Next. However, it leaves out the set-passengers step and the passengers and filters parameters, and it puts trip-type selection after the cities are entered instead of before, though the steps are still concrete enough to automate.
